rules.text: Born leader, presence felt everywhere, "life of the party"; confident, high self-esteem, ambitious, bold, straightforward; can be mistaken as egoistic/arrogant but warm-hearted

source.quote: Sun makes you a born leader, it makes your presence felt wherever you go

rules.say: You are a born leader whose presence is felt wherever you go. Confident, ambitious, bold and straightforward, you may sometimes be mistaken as proud, but you are warm-hearted.

rules.text: Wants to be number 1, stubborn, works very hard, takes leadership in any sphere; innovative, charming persuasive speaker; friends come for advice

source.quote: you want to become number 1 in whatever you do

rules.say: You want to be number 1 in whatever you do and work very hard to lead. Stubborn at times, you are innovative and a persuasive speaker, and friends come to you for advice.

rules.text: Desires royal lifestyle, spends extravagantly; advice: watch savings, don't overspend on possessions

source.quote: Advice for you would be to keep a check on your savings and finances

rules.say: You enjoy a royal lifestyle and can spend lavishly. Keep a check on your savings and avoid overspending on possessions.

rules.text: Conscious of public image, centre of attraction even when not wanting it; loyal "friend in need"; charismatic aura

source.quote: You enjoy being the center of attraction just like your ruling planet

rules.say: You are mindful of your public image and often become the centre of attraction, even without trying. You are a loyal friend in need, with a charismatic aura.

rules.text: Freedom lover, dislikes being dominated, "be your own boss"

source.quote: You believe in being your Boss.

rules.say: You love your freedom and dislike being dominated; you believe in being your own boss.

rules.text: Care: don't dictate to family/friends; don't let overconfidence/ego steer life; try to see others' view; accept delays and failures

source.quote: you must not dictate to others or let your authoritative nature overpower

rules.say: Take care not to dictate to family and friends or let ego and overconfidence steer your life. Try to see others' point of view, and accept delays and failures.

rules.text: Gets discouraged when not achieving; accept failure as experience

source.quote: you tend to become discouraged and downhearted when you do not achieve

rules.say: You can feel discouraged when you do not achieve what you wanted. Try to accept failure as experience.

rules.text: Most favourable period (Sun strongest): start ventures, investments, plans, auspicious work

source.quote: The most favorable time for you is the period between March 21st to August 20th

rules.condition: psychic = 1 AND date in 21 Mar - 20 Aug
rules.say: This is your most favourable time, when the Sun is strongest for you. It is a good time to start new ventures, investments, plans and auspicious work.

rules.text: Unfavourable (Sun weak): avoid new starts, big decisions, investments; may bring delays, stress, health issues, losses, false allegations

source.quote: avoid starting any new and important activity ... from October 15th to December 25th

rules.condition: psychic = 1 AND date in 15 Oct - 25 Dec
rules.say: This is an unfavourable time as the Sun is weak for you, so avoid new starts, big decisions and investments. It can bring delays, stress, health issues, losses or false allegations, so take care.

rules.text: Lucky colour red and shades of red: clothes, decor, red phone/cover, red lock-screen/home-screen wallpaper, bottle, keychain

source.quote: Red and shades of red are auspicious for you.

rules.say: Red and shades of red are lucky for you. You can use them in clothes, home decor, your phone cover or wallpaper, bottle and keychain.

rules.text: Nurturing, caring, sentimental, sensitive, intuitive; easily hurt by harsh words; calm and soothing; "motherly instincts"

source.quote: The moon shapes you to be very nurturing and caring

rules.say: You are nurturing, caring, sensitive and intuitive, with a calm, soothing nature and motherly instincts. Harsh words can hurt you easily.

rules.text: Peace-loving, avoids arguments, forgiving, loyal friend, emotional support, cannot say no

source.quote: Peace is your love language and you dislike engaging in arguments

rules.say: You love peace and avoid arguments; you are forgiving and a loyal friend who gives emotional support. You find it hard to say no.

rules.text: Impeccable counsellor; romantic and selfless in love; physically attractive; sense of aesthetics; family-oriented

source.quote: You are an impeccable counselor and know how to make others feel loved

rules.say: You are a wonderful counsellor who knows how to make others feel loved. Romantic and selfless in love, you have a fine sense of beauty and are family-oriented.

rules.text: Dreamer, imaginative, artistic, but struggles to execute; needs a reliable partner to execute ideas; needs constant assurance; shy, should ask for help

source.quote: finds it difficult to put your plans into action or reality

rules.say: You are imaginative and artistic but can find it hard to put plans into action. A reliable partner helps you execute ideas, and you need reassurance, so do ask for help.

rules.text: Indecisive (self-doubt, fickle mind); suppresses feelings to avoid quarrels; emotional ups and downs like the Moon; moody

source.quote: You can tend to be extremely moody and your sentiments mostly overpower you.

rules.say: You can be indecisive due to self-doubt, and you may hide your feelings to avoid quarrels. Like the Moon, your moods can rise and fall.

rules.text: Most favourable (Moon strongest): start ventures, investments, plans; good for self-discovery

source.quote: The most favorable and beneficial time for you is the month of June and July

rules.say: This is your most favourable time, when the Moon is strongest for you. It is good for starting new ventures, investments and plans, and for self-discovery.

rules.text: Unfavourable (Moon weak): avoid big decisions; anxiety, false scenarios in mind, over-emotional, slow growth; meditation recommended

source.quote: avoid making any important decisions during December, January, and February

rules.condition: psychic = 2 AND month in {Dec, Jan, Feb}
rules.say: This is an unfavourable time as the Moon is weak for you, so avoid big decisions. You may feel anxious, over-emotional or imagine false scenarios, and growth can be slow; meditation is recommended.

rules.text: Lucky colour white and shades of white (clothes, decor, phone, wallpaper, keychain)

source.quote: White and shades of white are auspicious for you.

rules.say: White and shades of white are lucky for you. You can use them in clothes, home decor, your phone, wallpaper and keychain.

rules.text: Very ambitious, self-motivated, hard work gives pleasure; won't settle for subordinate roles; devoted, disciplined

source.quote: It will not be wrong to say that hard work gives you pleasure.

rules.say: You are very ambitious and self-motivated, and hard work gives you pleasure. Devoted and disciplined, you do not settle for subordinate roles.

rules.text: Starts career early, hardship in early years sets up later success

source.quote: Psychic number 3 individuals start their careers early and might have to face hardship

rules.say: You tend to start your career early. Hardship in the early years can set you up for success later.

rules.text: Social, cheerful, good humour; religious/faith in Supreme Power; likes spotlight; optimistic manager

source.quote: You are religious and have faith in God

rules.say: You are social, cheerful and humorous, with faith in God. You like the spotlight and make an optimistic manager.

rules.text: Great multitasker but leans to work over home; work-life balance suffers

source.quote: sometimes you find it difficult to draw the line between personal and professional lives

rules.say: You are a great multitasker but lean towards work over home. Take care, as your work-life balance can suffer.

rules.text: Caring provider, but bossy/dictatorial with partner and family; keep authority in check

source.quote: your partner will also have to experience your bossy and dictatorial nature

rules.say: You are a caring provider, but you can be bossy with your partner and family. Keep your authority in check.

rules.text: Suited to leadership, orator, advisor, teacher, writer; articulate; can be too straightforward and short-tempered

source.quote: You can easily take up a leadership role, become an orator, an advisor, a teacher, or a writer.

rules.say: You are suited to leadership and can be an orator, advisor, teacher or writer. You speak well, but can be too straightforward and short-tempered.

rules.text: Life partner attractive and loyal; may have pre-marital relations with partners of psychic 1,3,6,9; respectful to partners

source.quote: You may have physical relationships with your partner having psychic numbers 1,3,6 or 9 before marriage.

rules.say: Your life partner is likely to be loyal, and you are respectful towards partners. You may get physically close before marriage with a partner whose birth number is 1, 3, 6 or 9.

rules.text: Care: give time to family; avoid over-ambition, impatience, excessive optimism, extravagance; tends to exaggerate/gossip

source.quote: psychic number 3 usually exaggerates the truth and creates false realities

rules.say: Give time to your family, and take care of over-ambition, impatience, excessive optimism and extravagance. You may also tend to exaggerate the truth or gossip.

rules.text: Favourable: start ventures, investments; good for travel

source.quote: Mid-February to Mid-March and November 25th to December 25th

rules.condition: psychic = 3 AND date in mid-Feb - mid-Mar OR 25 Nov - 25 Dec
rules.say: This is a favourable time for you to start new ventures and investments, and a good time for travel.

rules.text: Unfavourable: avoid new starts/investments (text is copied from number 1 and even says "the Sun is weak")

source.quote: from October 15th to December 25th as the Sun is weak during that phase

rules.condition: psychic = 3 AND date in 15 Oct - 25 Dec
rules.say: This is an unfavourable time for you, so avoid starting new and important work or investments.

rules.text: Lucky colours yellow, golden and shades

source.quote: Yellow, Golden, and shades of yellow and golden are auspicious for you.

rules.say: Yellow, golden and their shades are lucky for you.

rules.text: Rebellious, practical, analytical, organised, disciplined, hard-working, brainy; unique out-of-the-box ideas

source.quote: You are known to be rebellious and someone who is very practical and analytical

rules.say: You are rebellious yet practical, analytical, organised and hard-working. You are brainy and come up with unique, out-of-the-box ideas.

rules.text: Believes nothing without logic; firm opinions, stubborn; often misunderstood by family/friends

source.quote: you are often misunderstood by not only your acquaintances but also your family

rules.say: You believe nothing without logic and hold firm, sometimes stubborn opinions. You are often misunderstood, even by your family and friends.

rules.text: Bold, straightforward, can't sugar-coat; kind-hearted but seems harsh; few friends, quality over quantity; may feel lonely

source.quote: This trait of yours often leads you to feel lonely and isolated.

rules.say: You are bold and straightforward and cannot sugar-coat, so you may seem harsh though you are kind-hearted. You keep few but quality friends, and may sometimes feel lonely.

rules.text: Purposeful; not money-minded, prefers knowledge/experience; spends on wishes and helping others

source.quote: people with psychic number 4 are not money-minded

rules.say: You live with purpose and are not money-minded, valuing knowledge and experience more. You spend on your wishes and on helping others.

rules.text: Can be a great revolutionary; hard to beat in debate; supports underdogs; self-made after struggles

source.quote: you can prove to be a great revolutionary

rules.say: You can be a great revolutionary, hard to beat in debate, and you stand up for the underdog. You become self-made after struggles.

rules.text: Advice: listen to others, avoid harsh words, be flexible

source.quote: try avoiding the use of harsh and hurtful words to win over an argument

rules.say: Listen to others, avoid harsh words to win an argument, and try to be flexible.

rules.text: Good friends/partners: 1, 6, 7; also 2 and 5 compatible

source.quote: choose friends and partners whose psychic numbers are 1, 6, or 7

rules.say: Choose friends and partners whose birth number is 1, 6 or 7; people with 2 and 5 are also compatible with you.

rules.text: Avoid romantic or business partnership with 4 and 8

source.quote: Avoid romantic or business partnerships with individuals with psychic numbers 4 and 8

rules.say: Avoid romantic or business partnerships with people whose birth number is 4 or 8.

rules.text: Favourable: new venture/job, investments, travel

source.quote: March 20th to April 20th and July 10th to August 20th

rules.condition: psychic = 4 AND date in 20 Mar - 20 Apr OR 10 Jul - 20 Aug
rules.say: This is a favourable time for you to start a new venture or job, make investments and travel.

rules.text: Unfavourable: avoid new projects, decisions, investments; low motivation, fatigue, gloom; stomach or skin issues

source.quote: avoid starting any new and important project, or task during October, November, and December

rules.condition: psychic = 4 AND month in {Oct, Nov, Dec}
rules.say: This is an unfavourable time, so avoid new projects, big decisions and investments. You may feel low, tired or gloomy, so take care of your stomach and skin.

rules.text: Lucky colours black, grey and shades

source.quote: Black, grey, and shades of black and grey are auspicious for you.

rules.say: Black, grey and their shades are lucky for you.

rules.text: Childlike energy; makes others happy; adapts to any situation with ease; looks younger than age

source.quote: You carry childlike energy and aura around you.

rules.say: You carry a childlike energy that makes others happy, and you adapt to any situation with ease.

rules.text: Great communicator, convincing; can run a successful business with oratory and risk-taking; always thinking of ways to earn/invest

source.quote: You are a great communicator and possess exemplary communication skills.

rules.say: You are a great, convincing communicator and can run a successful business with your speaking skills and risk-taking. You are always thinking of new ways to earn and invest.

rules.text: Lifelong learner but bores quickly; switches jobs if bored; dislikes monotony; multiple income sources

source.quote: if their present job turns out to be boring ... they would not think twice before changing

rules.say: You love learning but get bored quickly and dislike monotony, so you may switch jobs when bored. You tend to have more than one source of income.

rules.text: Popular, but doesn't get good advice when needed; friend circle shrinks with age after betrayals

source.quote: over time your social circle becomes smaller and smaller

rules.say: You are popular, but you may not get good advice when you need it. After betrayals, your friend circle can shrink with age.

rules.text: Highly intuitive, senses true intentions; meditation sharpens it; never gives up, bounces back

source.quote: You are highly intuitive and can sense other people's true intentions.

rules.say: You are highly intuitive and can sense people's true intentions; meditation sharpens this gift. You never give up and always bounce back.

rules.text: Care: laziness can cause weight gain; control spending; short-lived anger

source.quote: being lethargic could lead to weight gain

rules.say: Take care of laziness, which can lead to weight gain, and keep your spending in control. Your anger tends to be short-lived.

rules.text: Favourable: new venture/job, plans; good to buy property and invest

source.quote: The most favorable time for you is the months of May, August, and September.

rules.condition: psychic = 5 AND month in {May, Aug, Sep}
rules.say: This is a favourable time to start a new venture or job and make plans. It is also good for buying property and investing.

rules.text: Unfavourable: avoid new starts, decisions, investments; isolation, doubting people, self-doubt

source.quote: avoid starting any new and important projects ... in January, April, and December and during Mercury Retrograde

rules.condition: psychic = 5 AND (month in {Jan, Apr, Dec} OR Mercury retrograde)
rules.say: This is an unfavourable time to start new and important projects, take big decisions or invest. You may feel isolated and doubt others as well as yourself.

rules.text: Lucky colour green and shades

source.quote: Green and shades of green are auspicious for you.

rules.say: Green and shades of green are lucky for you.

rules.text: Beautiful, youthful, magnetic; polite; neat, artistic surroundings; aesthetics important

source.quote: You are beautiful, youthful, and have a magnetic aura.

rules.say: You have a magnetic aura and polite manners. You like neat, artistic surroundings, and beauty matters a lot to you.

rules.text: Helpful, kind, sacrifices for loved ones; family-oriented

source.quote: You are family oriented and cherish spending time

rules.say: You are helpful and kind, ready to sacrifice for your loved ones, and deeply family-oriented.

rules.text: Heart over head, hypersensitive; hard to find true friends especially later; people take advantage; trust issues and isolation after being cheated

source.quote: You listen to your heart more than to your head.

rules.say: You follow your heart over your head, and people may take advantage of your sensitivity. True friends can be hard to find, and being cheated can leave you with trust issues.

rules.text: Loves luxury, brands, fragrance; likely shopaholic

source.quote: There is a high possibility that you are a shopaholic

rules.say: You love luxury, brands and fragrances, and there is a good chance you are a shopaholic.

rules.text: Empath, motherly, loves children and animals; music is therapeutic

source.quote: You are a true empath

rules.say: You are a true empath with a motherly nature who loves children and animals. Music works like therapy for you.

rules.text: Falls in love at least twice before marriage; often does not get back equal effort

source.quote: psychic number 6 individuals fall in love at least twice before tying the knot

rules.say: You may fall in love at least twice before marriage, and you often do not get back the same effort you give.

rules.text: Advice: boundaries, self-love; risk of alcohol/smoking when dejected; limit lavish spending; prone to evil eye, don't share plans until done

source.quote: You are highly prone to the evil eye

rules.say: Set boundaries and practise self-love; when low, take care to avoid alcohol or smoking, and limit lavish spending. You are prone to the evil eye, so don't share plans until they are done.

rules.text: Favourable: new venture/job, move to new property, buy house or vehicle; good news

source.quote: April 20th to May 20th and September 20th to October 20th

rules.condition: psychic = 6 AND date in 20 Apr - 20 May OR 20 Sep - 20 Oct (best 20-30 Apr, 1-20 Oct)
rules.say: This is a favourable time to start a new venture or job, move to a new property, or buy a house or vehicle. Good news can come your way.

rules.text: Unfavourable: avoid new starts/investments; health, bad news, hindrances, indecision, jealousy; decide with head not heart

source.quote: in April, October, November, and during Venus Retrograde

rules.condition: psychic = 6 AND (month in {Apr, Oct, Nov} OR Venus retrograde)
rules.say: This is an unfavourable time to start new work or investments, and may bring health troubles, bad news, hindrances, indecision and jealousy. Decide with your head, not your heart.

rules.text: Lucky colours white and rainbow colours

source.quote: White and rainbow colors are auspicious for you.

rules.say: White and rainbow colours are lucky for you.

rules.text: Calm, composed, big-hearted, caring, animal lover

source.quote: You possess a calm and composed demeanor with a big heart.

rules.say: You are calm, composed and big-hearted, caring by nature and a lover of animals.

rules.text: Reserved, introvert, slow to open up; seen as rude/arrogant at first; golden heart; serves others emotionally or financially but shouldn't overdo it

source.quote: most people ruled by psychic number 7 are introverts

rules.say: You are reserved and slow to open up, so people may first think you rude or arrogant, but you have a golden heart. You help others emotionally or financially, but shouldn't overdo it.

rules.text: Intuitive; drawn to occult (astrology, numerology, tarot); premonitions; good judge of character; meditate, seek a guru

source.quote: Occult sciences like Astrology, Numerology, Tarot ... interest you.

rules.say: You are intuitive, get premonitions and judge character well, and occult sciences like astrology, numerology and tarot interest you. Meditation and a guru's guidance can help you.

rules.text: Healers and teachers; suited to teaching, consulting, psychiatry, arts, politics, research

source.quote: Psychic number 7 ruled individuals are known to be exceptional healers and teachers

rules.say: You can be an exceptional healer and teacher, suited to teaching, consulting, psychiatry, arts, politics or research.

rules.text: Sensitive, spiritual, home-loving; low self-esteem in big groups; anxiety/overthinking; exercise, nature, meditation, live in present

source.quote: you struggle with low self-esteem and lack confidence

rules.say: You are sensitive, spiritual and home-loving, but may lack confidence in big groups and overthink. Exercise, nature, meditation and living in the present help you.

rules.text: Favourable: new ventures, opportunities, skills, lifestyle

source.quote: especially the period between June 20th to July 20th

rules.condition: psychic = 7 AND month in {Jun, Jul} (esp. 20 Jun - 20 Jul)
rules.say: This is a favourable time for you to begin new ventures, take up opportunities, learn new skills and change your lifestyle, especially between 20 June and 20 July.

rules.text: Unfavourable: avoid big decisions; aimlessness, dependence, misunderstandings, impulsive purchases, losses, drift from faith

source.quote: avoid making any important decisions during January and February

rules.say: This is an unfavourable time, so avoid big decisions. Take care of aimlessness, dependence, misunderstandings, impulsive purchases and losses, and stay close to your faith.

rules.text: Lucky colours black, grey and shades (same text as 4)

source.quote: Black, grey, and shades of black and grey are auspicious for you.

rules.say: Black, grey and their shades are lucky for you.

rules.text: Very hard-working, disciplined, focused; Saturn = ethics, rules, justice, delays; growth slow relative to effort; success after much struggle

source.quote: people ruled by psychic number 8 attain success after a lot of blood, sweat, and tears

rules.say: You are very hard-working, disciplined and focused, ruled by Saturn, the planet of rules and justice. Growth may feel slow for your effort, but success tends to come after much struggle.

rules.text: Resilient; will see big success late if they persist; hard work not luck

source.quote: For you, \"Hard work is the key to Success\"

rules.say: You are resilient: big success can come to you later in life if you keep going, through hard work rather than luck.

rules.text: Kind and generous but career focus can neglect family; alone when they need help

source.quote: you would find yourself alone when you seek assistance

rules.say: You are kind and generous, but focusing on career can make you neglect family. Take care, as you may find yourself alone when you need help.

rules.text: Professional, detail-oriented (sometimes slow), multitasker; great manager/planner; "quintessential money manager"; land, property, law suit careers

source.quote: Psychic number 8 is known to be a quintessential money manager.

rules.say: You are professional, detail-oriented, a great manager and planner, and a natural money manager. Careers in land, property and legal cases suit you.

rules.text: Should do fitness/sport; prone to depression from overthinking

source.quote: You are prone to depression due to these constant thoughts

rules.say: You are prone to overthinking, which can lead to depression, so keep up fitness or a sport.

rules.text: Betrayal can make them bitter/revengeful; Saturn punishes cheating/illegal acts quickly; patience

source.quote: Saturn takes absolutely no time in punishing them gravely

rules.say: Betrayal can make you bitter or revengeful, so stay patient. Saturn is quick to punish cheating or wrongdoing, so keep your dealings honest.

rules.text: Favourable: start ventures, investments

source.quote: the period between September 20th to October 20th

rules.condition: psychic = 8 AND date in 20 Sep - 20 Oct
rules.say: This is a favourable time for you to start new ventures and make investments.

rules.text: Unfavourable: avoid decisions; defamation, humiliation, losses, stomach/lower body issues; avoid arguments, love/business decisions, signing legal documents, moving house; avoid greed

source.quote: from January 15th to February 15th, March, April, and December

rules.condition: psychic = 8 AND (date in 15 Jan - 15 Feb OR month in {Mar, Apr, Dec})
rules.say: This is an unfavourable time, linked with losses and loss of face. Avoid arguments, greed, love or business decisions, signing legal papers and moving house, and take care of your stomach and lower body.

rules.text: Lucky colour blue and shades

source.quote: Blue and shades of blue are auspicious for you.

rules.say: Blue and shades of blue are lucky for you.

rules.text: Charismatic, energetic, physically active; authority, dominance, control

source.quote: makes you charismatic and a powerhouse of energy

rules.say: You are charismatic, energetic and physically active, a powerhouse with a natural sense of authority and control.

rules.text: Careers: sports, politics, soldiers, IAS officers, boxers; in desk jobs wants to lead, else frustrated

source.quote: professions such as sports, politics, soldiers, IAS officers, boxers

rules.say: Careers like sports, politics, the army, IAS or boxing suit you. In a desk job you want to lead, or you can feel frustrated.

rules.text: Humanitarian, loving; devoted to partner to the point of losing individuality; repays misbehaviour

source.quote: you start to lose your individuality, so be careful about that

rules.say: You are loving and humanitarian, and so devoted to your partner that you can lose your individuality, so be careful. You also tend to repay bad behaviour in kind.

rules.text: Straightforward, dislikes diplomacy, so does not get along well with psychic 5

source.quote: psychic number 9 natives do not get along very well with psychic number 5

rules.say: If someone close to you has birth number 5, you may not get along very well, as you are straightforward and dislike diplomacy.

rules.text: Short-tempered; anger at injustice

source.quote: Psychic number 9 is known for their anger

rules.say: You can be short-tempered, especially when you see injustice.

rules.text: Punctual, disciplined, great leader; best as own boss/business; arts (acting, singing, dancing), entertainment

source.quote: psychic number 9 should opt for being in a profession where they can be their boss

rules.say: You are punctual, disciplined and a great leader, best as your own boss or in business. Arts like acting, singing and dancing, and entertainment, also suit you.

rules.text: Secretive, hides weakness; should confide in a trusted person

source.quote: suppressing feelings and emotions is not good for your mental health

rules.say: You tend to be secretive and hide your weaknesses. Suppressing feelings is not good for your mental health, so confide in someone you trust.

rules.text: Channel energy into sport, else quarrels; prone to fights leading to accidents or court cases; meditate

source.quote: could further lead to serious situations like accidents or court cases

rules.say: Channel your energy into sport, or it can turn into quarrels. Fights can lead to accidents or court cases, so meditate and stay calm.

rules.text: Favourable: ventures, investments, risks; acquire land, property, vehicle

source.quote: March 20th to April 25th and October 20th to November 25th

rules.condition: psychic = 9 AND date in 20 Mar - 25 Apr OR 20 Oct - 25 Nov
rules.say: This is a favourable time for ventures, investments and taking risks, and for buying land, property or a vehicle.

rules.text: Unfavourable: misunderstandings, betrayal, cheating, accidents, ill health, losses; control anger

source.quote: during March, May, and June and from October 1st to October 20th

rules.condition: psychic = 9 AND (month in {Mar, May, Jun} OR date in 1-20 Oct OR 25 Nov - 25 Dec)
rules.say: This is an unfavourable time, linked with misunderstandings, betrayal, cheating, accidents, ill health and losses. Take extra care and keep your anger in control.

rules.text: Lucky colours dark red and blood red, and shades

source.quote: Dark red and Blood red are auspicious for you

rules.say: Dark red, blood red and their shades are lucky for you.
